title: GoCell Assembly Descriptor
description: Defines an Assembly, the physical packaging unit. K#10: minimal required = id+cells+owner; build fields are derived from cell.yaml type when omitted.

id.description: Unique assembly identifier. Must equal the directory name under assemblies/. 2-32 chars (composed-name budget for healthz probe).

cells.description: Cells included in this assembly. Each entry is either a bare cell id string (same-module shorthand) or an object {id, module} where module names the external Go module the cell is developed in (cell development in an independent repository, #1086). module omitted = the assembly's own module.

module.description: Go module path the cell's cellmodules/ package lives in (e.g. github.com/acme/payment-cell). Omit for the assembly's own module. Must be a declared go.mod/go.work dependency; the Go compiler enforces resolvability at build time.

build.description: Build configuration for the assembly. All fields optional; defaults are derived.

deployTemplate.description: Deployment template identifier. Omit to use the parser-applied default "k8s" (the JSON Schema `default` keyword is documentation only — actual defaulting happens in metadata.applyAssemblyDerivations).

compositionAPI.description: When true, GenerateModulesGen emits the runtime/composition.CellModule form (cellmodules/{cell}.Module() constructors) instead of the legacy local-CellModule-type form. Set true for cellmodules-based assemblies; REQUIRED when any cell declares a non-empty `module` (cross-module cell from an independent Go module, #1086) — the legacy form has no import path and cannot reference a foreign module.

topology.description: OPTIONAL deployment topology for this assembly. Absent or empty means all cells are co-located in the same process (zero-migration default). When non-empty, every cell in the assembly must appear in exactly one of colocated or remote (exhaustive partition). Validated at governance time by ValidateTopologyStructure.

colocated.description: Cell IDs that are deployed in the same process as this assembly. Must be a subset of the assembly's cells[] IDs and must not overlap with remote[].cellID.

items.description: Cell ID of a co-located cell. Must match the canonical CellIDPattern (lowercase letters and digits, starts with letter, 2-32 chars).

remote.description: Cells deployed as separate remote services reachable via a network endpoint. Must not overlap with colocated[].

cellID.description: Cell ID of the remote cell. Must match the canonical CellIDPattern and must be declared in the assembly's cells[].

endpoint.description: Network address of the remote cell service (e.g. host:port or https://host/). Must be a syntactically valid host:port or URL with a non-empty host. Validated by ValidateTopologyStructure at governance time.
